non_deterministic_artifacts.reason: Empirical-Bayes adaptive shrinkage of effect sizes (e.g. DESeq2/apeglm or ashr) fits a prior from the data whose shrinkage of the log2FoldChange and lfcSE columns is not bit-reproducible across BLAS threadings, and whose chosen engine may differ between the recorded run and a re-execution; the shrunken values may vary within the semantic band without indicating error. The unshrunken Wald stat/pvalue/padj (and thus the significant set) are unaffected.
